mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM abstract_user u INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.abstract_user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN abstract_role r ON r.id = ur.target_id AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.delete_flag = 0 AND (r.biz_domain_id = #{bizDomainId} OR r.biz_domain_id IS NULL) WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.delete_flag = 0
